title: Remote Monitoring Data Flow Graph Model
description: Step through concrete device readings, an illustrative alert rule, a telehealth visit, and a parallel patient-portal path.
creator: Modeling Healthcare Data with Graphs
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Healthcare graph modeling
Remote patient monitoring
Patient-generated data
chapter_title: Specialty Care, Surgery, and Remote Monitoring

learningObjectives: Explain how patient-generated data flows through remote monitoring into a telehealth visit, and classify nodes by data origin.

pedagogical.interactionPattern: Staged reveal with optional bounded playback
pedagogical.rationale: Concrete readings and a step-through rule evaluation support explanation without relying on continuous animation.
pedagogical.assessment: Explain the alert from the visible readings and classify the patient-originated and system-generated nodes.
